scope: The reconstructed cathedral on the plaza in San Ignacio de Velasco, Bolivia, with the wide tiled nave roof, plaza veranda, painted facade, flanking timber galleries and stairs, bell tower and mapped rear attachment as represented in September 2022.

references.filename: Iglesia Jesuita San Ignacio de Velasco.jpg

originalReview.notes: The plaza view shows the broad tiled gable, open timber colonnade, paired exterior stairs, deep entry and painted tower with its raised belfry gallery.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact first-party CC0 plaza photograph published by Qualla. The mapped outline and municipal text support the main church volume and the reconstructed era.
